text_block_list.name: Shakur (LANE)
text_block_list.text:
Meet me in the stands on campus in
thirty
minutes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur's summons is abrupt and
nondescript,
but I figure I'll see what she
needs me for once I
get there.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Look.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Those two are about to have a
scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Doto. How's your throat? I
assume
your vocal cords are nice and
warmed up for
today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Out on the tracks stands T.M. Opera O,
a racer
who's been crushing her senior
year with win after
win.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, ma'am! Wait, my throat?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with her is Meisho Doto, a runner of
equal
ability who's allegedly (?) biding
her time to
triumph over her rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Currently, they stand at the top as
leaders of the
Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-oh no, I'm so sorry! I didn't prepare
my vocal
cords at all!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Now that's a shame. We have such an
audience today, I thought we
could send
everyone off with a song at
the end.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'll go get some honey right awa—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why, look at you! You're in tip-top
shape! Come
on back here! We have a
race to run!

text_block_list.name: Opera O & Doto
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah!
Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-wow... They're running like it's a bona
fide
race, not just a little scrimmage...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The air almost seems to shimmer from
the sheer force emanating from them.
Their unparalleled
strength is the result
of diligent daily work.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Parcae predicts that I'll lose
spectacularly at the
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's multiple facets to it... but those
two are a major factor. The wall formed
by the people in
the years above isn't an
easy one to overcome.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in my year followin' this
path—including me—is doomed to fail
before even stepping foot
on their
shadows.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And when the next generation
eventually shows
up on the turf, even
they'll surpass us in the blink
of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: We're the weakest generation.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All right, you want my optimal route for
senior
year? There isn't one.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
According to Parcae's predictions, I'm
not gonna
win a single race after the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So this whole thing went beyond
whether Shakur was capable of winning...
The public's poor
predictions were
weighing on her too...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just 'cause my fate's changed doesn't
mean the
competition's gotten any
weaker.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Their stats are literally off the charts.
Those two are always practically
hand-in-hand, taking first
and second...
Anyone can see that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If this were a game, I could just put off
the battle,
grind out a few levels, then
come back to
challenge 'em again.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But there's no time to waste in the world
of
racing. It's not like we stay at our
physical peak
forever.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Instead of a seven-centimeter gap, now
I've got
boss monsters to deal with.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Talk about the worst game ever.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: Still, they sure look like they're...
Still, you look like you're having...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like my hunch was right. Could it
be I'm
starting to understand her a little
better?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Listen up. From this point onwards, the
conditions
for winnin' are simple.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All I gotta do is crush everyone. If I can
pull that
off, that'll automatically
default me to bein' the
top runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her senior year starts almost
immediately after the Japan Cup. It
seems she's willing to share an outline of
her future strategy and how she plans to
run.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Once I'm standin' at the top, it won't
matter what
people think. There'll be no
question who's the
real deal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her declaration makes her current grasp
of her situation clear as day. Air Shakur
performed
spectacularly during the
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, public opinion on her remains
largely ambivalent, and she's likely
trying to figure out why. But if her
response is to defeat everyone at the
top...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then she probably doesn't believe she's
had
enough overwhelmingly decisive
victories. In that
case...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: I'd like them to be an even taller...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And perhaps she could earn a title that
exceeds
the accolade of the Classic
Triple Crown.
choice_data_list: The bigger the impact when it brea...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
They're bad enough as it is. I don't need
'em to be
any stronger.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're aware of how strong they are,
right? I've
already analyzed their stats.
Now all that's left is
to train—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's not enough. Something's missing...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um... What do you mean, Opera O?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! Doto, you must undergo a

metamorphosis!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? A meta... Meta-what-now?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I wish to make the upcoming Japan Cup
a race to
remember! I want to fill it with
excitement like no
one has felt before.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If you, my rival, were to evolve and
chase after me with the grace of a
butterfly, the crowd is sure
to be
pleased!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And what greater show can we give than
if I were to become a bee and deliver
the final stinging
blow! But only you
hold the key to this possibility!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But I...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Will you come at me, Doto? Will you
charge at
me with such ferocity as
though to tear out my
throat?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-yes!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm? The air... It's shifted.

text_block_list.name: Opera O & Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaah!
Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This can't be. They're... they're getting
even
better.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Those two may be monsters, but even
monsters
have limits.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The rest is puzzle-solving. I could polish
my skills. I could work on controlling the
pace of the race
to my advantage... The
path to victory is varied.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But... It almost looks like Opera and
Doto just
broke their limits...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And so easily too...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after the race is over, Air Shakur
continues
to stare at them in silent
astonishment for some
time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I need to go. I have to add this to my

calculations.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Save your worries for someone who
needs it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's no question of what I need to
do. I hold myself to the threshold values
I've crunched out and win, just like I
planned—just like I always
have.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The seven-centimeter gap is a thing of
the past, and her senior year is a clean
slate to work with.
But what does Air
Shakur want from her future?
choice_data_list: What do you desire right now, and ...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Isn't that obvious? I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Victory serves as absolute and
irrefutable proof.
Who can argue I'm
wrong if I win?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I keep provin' I'm right, then all the
annoying
background noise should stop.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And to do that, I'm not gonna wait for
anyone to
give me props. I'll seize them
myself. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Doesn't matter. Anyway...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to fail at the Japan Cup.
This crappy
fate of mine has changed for
the better.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: There's no way I'm gonna lose here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"There's Air Shakur, the best of the
weakest generation. She really doesn't
stand a chance against anyone who came
before or after her,
does she?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I guess the writing was on the wall. It's
not like
she was ever strong. She just got
lucky, that's
all..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, I fell asleep. I've gotta hurry up
and
compile this—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzt! Bzzt!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Would you like to have some salt
ramen? It's my
treat if you come now! ♪"

Huh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzt! Bzzt, bzzt, bzzt...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Man, enough already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzt...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Now's not the time for a leisurely bowl
of ramen.
Even if I can't win, there's no
way I'm letting
myself get steamrolled.)
